AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  NOVEMBER 17, 2020
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
6833; MEETING ID: 837 6257 7373; PASSCODE: 502877 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM
OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR
CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-
agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957(a):
  THREAT TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles
  County Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

FLAG SALUTE
  Grissel Chavez
  Director of Public Safety

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel
  SPECIAL PRESENTATION
  City Council to proclaim November 28, as Small Business Saturday.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.

  2.  Caltrans Property Maintenance Update.

  3.  Halloween Fun House and Concert recap.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of October
  20 and 27, 2020. 825-04

  Report

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the periods September 20 –
   October 3, 2020, in the total amount of $949,184.56 and October 4 - October 17, 2020, in the total
  amount of $886,916.29. 630

  Report

3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant registers for the
  periods October 14 – October 27, 2020, in the amount of $3,725,726.22 and October 28 – November
  10, 2020, in the amount of $3,034,312.38. 640

  Report

4.  CLAIMS AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claims filed by Margaret L.
  Belote and Jalessa Calhoun. 830-02/03

  Report

5.  AWARD OF CONTRACT – HEATING, VENTILATION, AND AIR CONDITIONING (HVAC) DUCT
  CLEANING AT CITY FACILITIES – Staff recommends City Council approve a contract with Action Duct
  Cleaning Company, Inc. for heating, ventilation and air conditioning duct cleaning at City facilities in the
  amount of $135,375; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract and any amendments or
  extensions provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City
  Attorney. 920-12

  Report

6.  AWARD OF CONTRACT – RENTAL AND CLEANING OF UNIFORMS AND RELATED PRODUCTS -
  Staff recommends City Council approve participation in the Sourcewell Cooperative Purchasing
  Program for the term ending May 24, 2024, for rental and cleaning of uniforms and related products;
  and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract and any amendments or extensions provided
  there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 135-01-04

  Report

7.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-68 – AUTHORIZING THE CITY’S APPLICATION FOR GRANT FUNDS FOR
  THE STATEWIDE PARK DEVELOPMENT AND COMMUNITY REVITALIZATION PROGRAM –
  PROPOSITION 68 - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-68, A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING THE APPLICATION FOR
  STATEWIDE PARK DEVELOPMENT AND COMMUNITY REVITALIZATION PROGRAM GRANT
  FUNDS FOR HERMOSILLO PARK. 420-03

  Report

8.  AUTHORIZATION TO EXECUTE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING FOR ALLOCATION OF
  PROPOSITION A 40% DISCRETIONARY GRANT FUNDS – Staff recommends City Council approve
  the Memorandum of Understanding with the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority
  for the use of Proposition A 40% Discretionary Grant Funds in the amount of $2,157,062 covering the
  period of July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2030; and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  Memorandum of Understanding on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1110

  Report

9.  AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE CRISIS COMMUNICATION SERVICES AGREEMENT - Staff
  recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 1 to the crisis communication consulting services
  agreement with Merino, Barajas & Associates, Inc. not to exceed $28,500; and authorize the City
  Manager to execute this amendment and any future amendments, provided there is funding in the
  budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 710-07

  Report

10. PROJECT NO. 7228 - AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AND
  INSPECTION SERVICES FOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS – ROSECRANS AVENUE
  BETWEEN STUDEBAKER ROAD AND CARMENITA ROAD, FEDERAL PROJECT NO. HSIPL-
  5347(38) - ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-19 - Staff recommends City Council approve an agreement
  with FCG Consultants of Yorba Linda, in an amount not to exceed $169,981.31 for construction
  management and inspection services for Project No. 7228, Traffic Signal and Curb Ramp
   Improvements on Rosecrans Avenue Between Studebaker Road and Carmenita Road; and authorize
  the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments, provided there is funding in the
  budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7228

  Report

11. PROJECT NO. 7230 - AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AND
  INSPECTION SERVICES FOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS ON SAN ANTONIO
  DRIVE/NORWALK BOULEVARD AND ON CIVIC CENTER DRIVE, FEDERAL PROJECT NO. HSIPL-
  5347(40) - ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-20 - Staff recommends City Council approve an agreement
  with FCG Consultants of Yorba Linda, in an amount not to exceed $95,815.72 for construction
  management and inspection services for Project No. 7230, Traffic Signal and Curb Ramp
  Improvements on San Antonio Drive/Norwalk Boulevard and on Civic Center Drive; and authorize the
  City Manager to execute the agreement and amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on
  behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7230

  Report

12. RESOLUTION NO. 20-74 – LOS ANGELES COUNTY CARES CONTRACT – Staff recommends City
  Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-74, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CARES CONTRACT BETWEEN THE
  CITY OF NORWALK AND THE CHILD CARE ALLIANCE OF LOS ANGELES FOR FUNDING OF
  THE CARES ACT UNTIL DECEMBER 30, 2020; and

  b.  authorize the City Manager to execute the contract and any amendments, provided there is
  funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 710-07

  Report

13. AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 1 - PURCHASE OF THREE PARATRANSIT VANS - Staff
  recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 1 with Creative Bus Sales, Inc. to acquire three (3)
  Starcraft Allstar Class C paratransit vans in the amount of $246,703; and authorize the City Manager to
  execute the amendment, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 634-03

  Report

14. AUTHORIZATION TO SUBMIT ANNUAL SHORT RANGE TRANSIT PLAN FOR FISCAL YEARS 2021-
  2023 - Staff recommends City Council receive and file the Triennial Short Range Transit Plan, and
  authorize the Executive Director of Regional Transportation to submit the updated Short Range Transit
  Plan to Metro. 1130

  Report

15. AMENDMENT TO DUNCAN SOLUTIONS/PROFESSIONAL ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT, LLC
  AGREEMENT FOR PARKING CITATION MANAGEMENT AND COLLECTION SERVICES - Staff
  recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 1 to Duncan Solutions/Professional Account
  Management, LLC agreement for parking citation management and collection services to extend the
  term until January 31, 2027, and may be extended for up to five additional one-year periods; and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the
  City Attorney. 616-04

  Report

16. AGREEMENTS TO PROVIDE ON-CALL BUILDING & SAFETY AND PLANNING CONSULTING
  SERVICES - Staff recommends City Council approve agreements with the seven (7) selected firms
  listed above to provide on-call planning and/or on-call building and safety related services for a term of
  three (3) years from the date of execution, in an amount not to exceed $150,000 annually for each firm;
  and authorize the City Manager to execute agreements and any amendments provided there is funding
  in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 300

  Report
   17. RESOLUTION NO. 20-75 – AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER OR HIS DESIGNEE TO SIGN
  MINISTERIAL DOCUMENTS RELATED TO FEDERALLY FUNDED GRANTS FOR CAPITAL
  IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS AND REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. 20-64 - Staff recommends City
  Council adopt Resolution No. 20-75, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER OR HIS DESIGNEE TO SIGN ALL DOCUMENTS
  RELATED TO FEDERAL AND STATE FUNDED GRANTS FOR CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT
  PROJECTS ON BEHALF OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AND REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. 20-64.
  1005-04

  Report

  18. RESOLUTION NO. 20-76 - REPORTING OF THE EMPLOYER’S CONTRIBUTION FOR
  MANAGEMENT UNIT EMPLOYEES UNDER THE PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’ MEDICAL AND HOSPITAL
  CARE ACT - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-76, A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 19-59, AND FIXING
  THE EMPLOYER CONTRIBUTION AT AN EQUAL AMOUNT FOR EMPLOYEES AND ANNUITANTS
  UNDER THE PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’ MEDICAL AND HOSPITAL CARE ACT FOR MANAGEMENT
  EMPLOYEES. 135-01-03

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  19. ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

PUBLIC HEARINGS

  20. RESOLUTION NO. 20-69 - PREFERENTIAL PARKING ZONE FOR THE 12600 BLOCK OF
  PADDISON AVENUE, BETWEEN LYNDORA STREET AND ADOREE STREET (WEST SIDE) AND IN
  FRONT OF 12622 AND 12630 PADDISON AVENUE (EAST SIDE) – Staff recommends City Council
  adopt Resolution No. 20-69, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  SETTING FORTH ITS FINDING OF FACT AND APPROVING THE INSTALLATION OF THE
  PREFERENTIAL PARKING ZONE FOR THE 12600 BLOCK OF PADDISON AVENUE, BETWEEN
  LYNDORA STREET AND ADOREE STREET (WEST SIDE), AND IN FRONT OF 12622 AND 12630
  PADDISON AVENUE (EAST SIDE). 1050-02-02

  Report

  21. RESOLUTION NO. 20-70 - PETITION FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF PREFERENTIAL PARKING ZONE
  FOR THE NORTHSIDE OF FERINA STREET, FROM 11003 FERINA STREET TO 11017 FERINA
  STREET; AND SOUTHSIDE OF FERINA STREET FROM 15202 STUDEBAKER ROAD TO 15203
  ALLINGHAM AVENUE - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-70, A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK SETTING FORTH ITS FINDING OF FACT
  AND APPROVING THE INSTALLATION OF THE PREFERENTIAL PARKING ZONE FOR THE
  NORTH SIDE OF FERINA STREET, FROM 11003 FERINA STREET TO 11017 FERINA STREET; AND
  SOUTH SIDE OF FERINA STREET FROM 15202 STUDEBAKER ROAD TO 15203 ALLINGHAM
  AVENUE. 1050-02-02

  Report

REPORTS

  22. PROJECT NO. 7924 - RESOLUTION NO. 20-71 – BUDGET AMENDMENT AND AWARD
  CONTRACTS – CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL
  STREETS REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 24, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-16 –
  Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-71, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “M” BOND PROCEEDS TO PROJECT NO.
  7924 - CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREETS
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 24, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-16, in the
   amount of $807,661;

  b.  award a contract to CJ Concrete Construction in the amount of $671,690.00 for Measure M funded
  Local Street Rehabilitation;

  c.  award a contract to JM Diaz, Inc. in the amount of $107,303.57 for construction management and
  inspection services; and

  d.  authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any amendments, provided there is
  funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in forms approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7924

  Report

23. PROJECT NO. 7925 - RESOLUTION NO. 20-72 – BUDGET AMENDMENT AND AWARD
  CONTRACTS – CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL
  STREET REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 27, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-17 –
  Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-72, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “R” BOND PROCEEDS TO PROJECT NO.
  7925 - CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREET
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 27, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-17, in the
  amount of $2,015,968; and

  b.  award a contract to Kalban Inc., for Measure R funded Local Street Rehabilitation in the amount of
  $1,743,830; and

  c.  award a contract to Mark Thomas Company in the amount of $250,000 for construction
  management and inspection services; and

  d.  authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any amendments, provided there is
  funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in forms approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7925

  Report

24. PROJECT NO. 7926 - RESOLUTION NO. 20-73 – BUDGET AMENDMENT AND AWARD CONTRACT
  – CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREET
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 32, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-18 – Staff
  recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-73, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE MEASURE “R” BOND PROCEEDS TO PROJECT NO.
  7926 - CONSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREET
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM – PHASE 1 ZONE 32, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-18, in the
  amount of $843,373.00; and

  b.  award a contract to CJ Concrete Construction for Measure R funded Local Street Rehabilitation in
  the amount of $729,487.00; and

  c.  award a contract to Onward Engineering, Inc. in the amount of $97,166 for construction
  management and inspection services; and

  d.  authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any amendments, provided there is
  funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in forms approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7926

  Report

25. CORONAVIRUS PANDEMIC – NOVEMBER EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER UPDATE -
  Receive and file. 710-07

  Report
 ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated November 12, 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
